context: A boss explains urban risk management to a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 支障/通行/務める/打ち出し/最善/適度/応える/相次い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、都市部の通行規制、企業に大きな支障を生むんだ。
lines.en: Ren, traffic restrictions in the city put real strain on businesses.
lines.style: Measured opening, like laying out a fact that matters. Slight emphasis on 「大きな」 — not lecturing, but establishing context. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who's learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 担当を務める部署、対応策を相次いで出されてるんですね。
lines.en: So the department in charge is coming up with countermeasures one after another.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through a careful formality. Slight lean forward — he's connecting the dots aloud. Not quite a question, but almost. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 適度な余裕を見越して、最善策を打ち出している。
lines.en: We're thinking ahead — building in some buffer — so we can put together the best approach.
lines.style: Calm, declarative. The confidence of someone explaining a strategy they've already tested. Slight pause before 「最善策」 — showing he's considered the weight of it. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の要望に応える姿勢、勉強になります。
lines.en: That approach — really listening to what the region needs — I can learn from that.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. The voice of someone genuinely impressed by something they didn't expect. No flattery — just honest observation. Slight trailing-off at the end, like he's still thinking about it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実地視察、来週連れて行く。
lines.en: I'll take you on a site visit next week.
lines.style: Shift to warmth and quiet confidence. Brief, decisive — the closing statement of someone who sees potential and is about to show him why it matters. Slight softness underneath the directness.
